title: A rule for a whole common domain such as gmail.com asks first
steps: Launch with -UseFakeGmail (fake mail only); open Settings > Blocked, type gmail.com and press Block
In the alert press Cancel; type gmail.com again, press Block, choose Block Entire Domain, then Unblock it
Type acme.example and press Block, then Unblock it
In Settings > Importance & labels press Add rule…, choose Domain and Never important, type hotmail.co.uk and press Save; press Cancel in the alert
expected: Both gmail.com tries show a native alert, 'Block everyone at gmail.com?', saying it is a shared email provider, with Cancel as the default. Cancel saves nothing; Block Entire Domain adds the rule. acme.example is blocked without an alert. The hotmail.co.uk rule asks the same way. Blocking the domain of a Gmail sender's conversation offers Block This Address Only first.
